note: Formal six-round three-step verification for the 2026-11-05 transport-readiness round. LIBERO task 7 is the anchor (turn_on_stove). Seeds 3, 4 and 5 are init indices that appear in no earlier round: the 2026-11-04 delivery rounds used seeds 0, 1 and 2, and the offline calibration and the development rounds also used seeds 0 and 1 only. Three English and three Chinese rounds; each language carries one frozen base-suite high-level phrasing, one explicit ordered instruction, and one high-level phrasing that appears in no frozen routing set (so the routing generalisation is measured, not assumed). Every round is run once, in this order, and is never retried or skipped; a failed round stays in the denominator. Rounds are executed with the shipped config (config_demo_b900: max_seat_delta_m=0.029, perched_is_warning=true), the official pi05 weights, execute_horizon=5, budgets 1:300/2:600/3:300 and the action_retreat handoff.
